components.description: Get started with our free templates!
Discover what our customers have to say about their experience with us!

testimonials.name: Alex
testimonials.comment: Tried like 4 quiz tools for our lead gen funnel before this and honestly this is the only one I didn't end up hating. AI did most of the work and the customization actually works.

testimonials.name: Bency
testimonials.comment: Formester's AI form generator transformed how quickly we build forms. The drag-and-drop builder paired with AI-generated templates means I can spin up a survey or poll in minutes, not hours. Conditional logic, file uploads, and seamless integrations make it incredibly versatile and the customization options let every form match our branding perfectly. Their support team is exceptional too. It's the only form and survey tool we recommend

testimonials.name: Bob
testimonials.comment: We have been in business for over thirty years and were never happy with our forms until we found Formester. Now, we have clients actually enjoying completing and submitting online forms. If you are looking for a platform to create online forms... look no further – Formester is the best. Your clients will thank you!

testimonials.name: Thibaud Martinez
testimonials.comment: I really enjoy Formester. It’s clean and straight-forward and it does well, what it is supposed to do.

testimonials.name: Jilson
testimonials.comment: Formester is really easy to use and an exceptional alternative for Typeform. We use it for call for papers, lead registrations, feedback and surveys and it cannot be simpler.

testimonials.name: Chris
testimonials.comment: Very intuitive and the surveys look genuinely professional out of the box. Most importantly, I requested a custom rating scale and they shipped it within hours. Stellar support that is hands-down better than the Jotform.

faqList.header: Why switch from Formstack to Formester?
faqList.body: Formester is faster, easier, and more intuitive. You can build forms, quizzes, and surveys without the steep learning curve or complex interface that Formstack often requires.
faqList.body_markdown: Formester is faster, easier, and more intuitive. You can build forms, quizzes, and surveys without the steep learning curve or complex interface that Formstack often requires.

faqList.header: Does Formester offer the same advanced features as Formstack?
faqList.body: Yes. You get conditional logic, calculations, AI suggestions, submission controls, and integrations—without paying high fees or dealing with cluttered settings.
faqList.body_markdown: Yes. You get conditional logic, calculations, AI suggestions, submission controls, and integrations—without paying high fees or dealing with cluttered settings.

faqList.header: Is Formester more affordable than Formstack?
faqList.body: Absolutely. Formester provides advanced features at a lower cost, with no hidden fees or expensive add-ons, making it a smarter choice for teams of any size.
faqList.body_markdown: Absolutely. Formester provides advanced features at a lower cost, with no hidden fees or expensive add-ons, making it a smarter choice for teams of any size.

faqList.header: Can I collect payments or approvals like in Formstack?
faqList.body: Yes. Formester supports secure payment collection, approvals, and workflow automation—all in one place without needing extra tools or add-ons.
faqList.body_markdown: Yes. Formester supports secure payment collection, approvals, and workflow automation—all in one place without needing extra tools or add-ons.

faqList.header: How easy is it to collaborate with my team?
faqList.body: Formester lets your team build, edit, and manage forms together in real time. Unlike Formstack, you don’t need complicated setups or multiple accounts for collaboration.
